## 1.0.0 (2026-11-06)

### Features

* first publish ([ac5eec5](https://github.com/M4TH1EU/veloce-patches/commit/ac5eec56ee3fc1f097a4739642645e55903fabbd))
* initial waze patch ([0794bd5](https://github.com/M4TH1EU/veloce-patches/commit/0794bd51ed7a1ee23d1dce4f7c639a21ff2eef83))
* spotify, ha, audiobookshelf, waze patches ([4ed2522](https://github.com/M4TH1EU/veloce-patches/commit/4ed2522cb84ad94e83b3ca6b57971241eba46fed))

patches.name: Allow Veloce media browsing
patches.description: Add Veloce (or a custom host package) to Audiobookshelf's accepted media browsers. Other callers keep their existing access policy.

options.description: Application ID of the host to allow. Defaults to Veloce; change this for a custom host build.

patches.name: Allow Veloce media browsing
patches.description: Trust Veloce (or a custom host package, UID and signing certificate) and use Spotify's existing Android Auto browser integration.

options.description: SHA-256 of the certificate signing the installed host APK. Defaults to Veloce's release certificate. Override for a differently signed build. Colons and spaces are accepted; no private key is needed.
Application ID of the host to allow. Defaults to Veloce; change this for a custom host build.

patches.name: Allow custom car hosts
patches.description: Add Veloce (or a custom host package and signing certificate) to Waze's AndroidX host allowlist. Preserves validation of other hosts.

options.description: Application ID of the host to allow. Defaults to Veloce; change this for a custom host build.
SHA-256 of the certificate signing the installed host APK. Defaults to Veloce's release certificate. Override for a differently signed build. Colons and spaces are accepted; no private key is needed.

patches.name: Allow Veloce car host
patches.description: Trust Veloce (or a custom host package and signing certificate) in Home Assistant full. Preserves validation of other hosts. Car telemetry requires host support.

options.description: SHA-256 of the certificate signing the installed host APK. Defaults to Veloce's release certificate. Override for a differently signed build. Colons and spaces are accepted; no private key is needed.
Application ID of the host to allow. Defaults to Veloce; change this for a custom host build.
